name: video-editing-skill
title_zh: 剪哪刀、接哪帧、变速多少，全按你写的来
tagline_zh: 把剪辑意图写成结构化请求，它逐条映射到源素材时间轴并验证。不碰命令行、不传滤镜串。
tagline_en: Turn a structured edit intent into verified timeline operations with exact source mapping. No argv, no filter.
desc_en: Deterministic video editing from a typed edit request (trim, cut, concat with transitions, speed change, fit / fill / resize, still-image overlay) with an exact source-to-timeline mapping and per-operation provenance. Executes through ffmpeg-skill; never takes commands, argv, filter strings or executables. Use when an agent has already decided what to edit and needs the edit performed, verified an
why_zh: 每个操作都带来源到时间轴的精确映射和逐条溯源，执行后自动验证。不是黑盒调 ffmpeg，而是可审计。
why_en: Every op carries source-to-timeline provenance and post-execution verification. It's not a ffmpeg wrapper—it's a deterministic.
limit_zh: 只处理已明确的剪辑操作（裁剪、拼接、变速、缩放、静图叠加），不含转场创意、调色、字幕生成。
limit_en: Only trim/cut/concat/speed/resize/still-overlay; no creative transitions, color, or subtitles. Requires ffmpeg-skill installed and real input file.
title_en: Deterministic cuts, joins, speeds from a typed edit request
